source_title: DCC Continuous Compliance and NCA Evaluation
source_text: In order tocomply with item 3 of article 10 of NCA’s mandate and as per the Royal Decree number (57231) dated 10/11/1439H, all organizations within the scope of these controls must implement whatever necessary to ensure continuous compliance with the controls, which cannot be achieved without achieving continuous compliance with the Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC –1: 2018) where applicable. NCA evaluates organizations’ compliance with the DCC through multiple means such as self-assessments by the organizations, and/or external assessments, in accordance with the mechanisms deemed appropriate by NCA.
source_summary: Organizations within scope must take necessary measures to ensure continuous compliance with the controls, including continuous compliance with applicable ECC controls, and must support NCA compliance evaluations through self-assessments and/or external assessments using mechanisms NCA deems appropriate.
